name: McCormick
gaps: Source query returned 2203 rows; 1863 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.

Parcels are SC RFA McCormick Parcels (county-specific layer w/ CAMA, boundary program map) (https://services9.arcgis.com/RvqSyw3diI7dTKo5/arcgis/rest/services/Edgefield_McCormick_Greenwood_Web_Map_WFL1/FeatureServer/7). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
tax usable: RFA McCormick Parcels layer 7 (county CAMA join, 2025-11-04 load). Numeric values stored as strings; RFA/18 M_Value (12128>0) mirrors taxTotMark.
sale usable: Parse %m/%d/%Y %I:%M:%S %p. Note taxTransfe/taxTrans1 are a boolean flag + a date — do not confuse with sale price. Stale ~2025-11.
owner usable: Owner + mailing public on RFA layer 7.
qPublic and Beacon property-appraiser links are stored as patterns and were not requested.
Owner phone and email are not ingested. SCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.

Parcel polygons now loadable from SC RFA Statewide_Parcels (layer 18, where County='McCormick County') plus RFA county-specific layer; state-hosted inside boundary-program maps — fragile, snapshot extracts. No county-published parcel REST found 2026-09-28.
